# ZEC captured-event backtests

Version: 1.0.1
Canonical shared empirical archive for captured Coinbase ZEC-USD at1m5m10m1h. One day; no validated accuracy or durable edge.

- [Full report](llms-full.txt): methods, outcomes, exclusions, costs and limits.
- [All results](results.csv):10576rows, keyed by actual interval, template candidate ID and fee.
- [Summary](summary.json): coverage and descriptive maxima.
- [Frozen plan](plan.json.gz): gzip JSON containing all827spot templates and50Volty configurations.
- [Coverage](coverage.json): actual bars and warmup history.
- [Implementation](identity.json): exact imported code and dependency versions.
- [Original run manifest](manifest.json): hashes for complete private artifacts, including all fills and prepared tape.
- [Independent audit](audit.json): readback and independent ledger results.

Mongo research run: run:55f2cb71690fb0115c42324012967ff835eb3137e4a7f3cd6a80522a335123d0. Persistence is empirical evidence storage, not trusted literature qualification.
